In this video Top Gear examines a new Chinese supercar that wants to destroy the Porsche 911. Called the Denza Z, it’s a 2+2 that boasts 1583bhp and it’ll go on sale – alongside a shooting brake aimed squarely at Porsche’s Panamera and Taycan estate – later in 2026. When Porsche’s sales in China have slumped and profits are massively down, might this newcomer be its worst nightmare?
